factBeats.text: Adam Jones was once an "adrenalized chef" who earned two Michelin stars for his Parisian restaurant.
He lost his prestigious status due to a downfall involving "drugs, women, and way too much gambling."
Now in recovery, Adam is ready to make his comeback.
His ultimate goal is to "hang a third star on his restaurant shingle."
